name: The Turncoat

angles.text: Infiltration, defection, and ambush are familiar to a Rogue. Cultists who break ranks risk silence or a blade. The assassins outside show how secrecy can cut both ways in the highlands.

faq.answer: The turncoat was a former member of the Al'Aketh cult who claimed to know the cult's true intentions for the island. He offered to defect and share what he knew in exchange for protection.
The Al'Aketh are an enigmatic cult operating in the region. Their plans for the island remain hidden behind secrecy and zealotry, so local authorities risk much to reach deserters willing to speak.
The defector hid in a secluded residence in the highlands northwest of Valanaar. He waited there for an escort, trusting in promises of protection.
By the time anyone reached the secluded highland residence, assassins had tracked down and slain the defector. He was found dead inside the house, beyond questioning.
After the assassins outside were dealt with, a glint on the dead defector's body caught the eye. The shiny item remained, and may hold a clue to the secrets he carried.
faq.q: What did the turncoat leave behind?

faq.answer: The cultist claims to know the Al'Aketh's true intentions for the island and will defect only with assurances of protection. What drove him to leave the cult is not known.
faq.q: Why did the cultist decide to defect?

sections.body: A cultist within the Al'Aketh ranks claims to know the cult's true intentions for the island. He offers to defect, but demands firm assurances of protection. The cult guards its plans closely, so reaching out may be worth the danger.
sections.title: A Broken Oath

sections.body: The defector waits alone in a secluded residence in the highlands northwest of Valanaar. You must reach him with care. The meeting may be an Al'Aketh ambush meant to draw out those who pry into the cult's affairs.
sections.title: The Highland Hideout

sections.body: The defector lies dead inside the secluded highland house. Assassins tracked him down and struck before an escort could arrive. Outside, fallen assassins mark the aftermath. A gleam on the dead turncoat's body hints that he left an answer behind.
sections.title: Silence in the Highlands

summary: A cultist of the Al'Aketh offers to defect and reveal what the cult intends for the island. You are sent to bring him from a secluded highland retreat northwest of Valanaar, where the meeting may be a trap.
